scientific_intent.scientific_task: Evaluate a softened, cutoff radial particle force correction and update three Cartesian velocity-like arrays.
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Delta_v_i=fcoeff*sum_j m_j*I(r²<.5)*[(r²+.03)^(-3/2)-P5(r²)]*(r_j-r_i), with native Float32 coefficients andfcoeff=.23.
scientific_intent.discretization_or_topology: 784 target particles independently scan15000 source candidates, structure-of-arrays coordinates/mass; fixed collinear source fixture and radial cutoff.
invariants: Self interaction has zero Cartesian displacement and finite softened factor.
Each output target has a single writer; no inter-thread reduction or atomics.
Original input recurrence is verified byte-for-byte against native C++ at setup.
accuracy_requirements: All2352 active Float32 components, original absolute1 vs native/Julia artifacts and nativeFloat32gold.
Independent Float64 radial formula on identical coordinates/coefficients, absolute1 and relative1e-4, finite checks. Observed maxabsolute.14179583 and relative3.55811e-6.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Repeated Float32 accumulation, polynomial contraction, cutoff decisions and sqrt/div lowering. Native/Julia difference.01171875, beloworiginal1; exact causes not profiled.
scientific_intent.input_size_regimes: Original784x15000=11760000 logical pair iterations,4groups256threads, one update pertrial. Inputs240KB fitcache; large-target-count scaling unmeasured.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: LLNL CORAL summary identifies cosmological collisionless N-body short-force evaluation; this port measures the extracted kernel only.
scientific_intent.uncertainty: No physical units, actual snapshot, integrator, expansion history or end-to-end cosmological observable is tested.
